latin: Cum dicit Plato in mundi medio positam animam, de inparticipata anima debet intelligi, quam ideo in medio dicit positam, quia aequaliter omnibus adest, ab omni respectu et particulari habitudine liberata.
translation: When Plato says that the soul is placed in the middle of the world, this should be understood of the unparticipated soul, which he says is placed in the middle for this reason: that it is equally present to all things, free from every relation and particular disposition.
